o.text: Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *sǖr-, cognate with Turkish sürmek.

Inherited from Proto-Turkic *yogrut (“curdled, coagulated milk”), from *yogur- (“to knead, to fluff up, to condense”) *-ut. Equivalent to yoğur- (“to knead”) + -d.
cognates
Cognate with Old Uyghur 𐽶𐽳𐽲𐽾𐽳𐾀 (yogrut, “yogurt”), Turkish yoğurt, Kyrgyz жуурат (juurat), and Yakut суорат (suorat).
From Proto-Turkic *bōńduruk (“yoke”). By surface analysis, izafet I compound of boyun + duruq. Cognate with Turkish boyunduruk, Kyrgyz моюнтурук (moyunturuk), Uzbek boʻyinturuq, etc.
Adapted from Russian редактировать (redaktirovatʹ), ultimately Latin redactus.
